issue_context.title: Introduce basic compatibility control mechanism to optimizer
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

### Background

- We already have quite a few variables to control the behavior of optimizers. 
- In some circumstances, the change of optimizer behavior doesn't apply to most scenarios. Appending new variables is painful. 
- In database upgrading, making execution plans stable for a few conservative customers is not possible. 

### Design

Add a new session/global level system variable `tidb_opt_fix_control`.

Its value is a string. The default value is an empty string. A valid value must be in the format of "`<#issue1>:<value1>,<#issue2>:<value2>...`", like `set @@tidb_opt_fix_control = '99999:"on"'`.

This variable provides a list of "fix control", which is for controlling a specific behavior of the optimizer, and can be set to a value. A `<#issueN>:<value>` is for setting a fix control. The `<#issueN>` in it is an issue number that corresponds to a GitHub issue: `https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/<#issueN>`, descriptions related to this fix control should be placed in this issue.


### Test

- Set the system variable to a valid format, the content can be correctly recognized in tidb.
- Set the system variable to a invalid format, tidb will return an error and the internal state of tidb is not updated.
- Set the same "fix control" multiple times, tidb will return a warning and only the last one takes effect.
